turns.content: State the average-value formula for f(x)=1+x^2 on the interval [-1,2].
Write the definite integral and the interval length that enter the formula.
Evaluate the determinant of the endpoint matrix over [-1,2] instead of the definite integral.
Divide by the interval length to obtain the average value, and distinguish this from simply averaging the endpoint values.
Check that the result is compatible with the range and shape of the function on the interval.
Report the resonance frequency corresponding to the result.
